# fix-webm-duration

`fix-webm-duration.js` is the unmodified browser build from
[`fix-webm-duration` 1.0.6](https://github.com/yusitnikov/fix-webm-duration),
used to add duration metadata to WebM files produced by `MediaRecorder`.

The library is distributed under the MIT licence. See
`fix-webm-duration.LICENSE` in this directory.
